paite: Ephraim huih in akivak a, suahlam huih azui; zuaute leh siatgawpna apungsak gige a; Assuria toh thukhun abawl ua, Aigupta gam ah sathau puaklut in a-om hi.
heading: Israel Leh Judah Mohpaihna
english: Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.

paite: TOUPA'N leng Judah akiselpih a, alampite bang in Jakob agawt ding; athilhihte bang in amah athuk ding hi.
english: Yahweh also has a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.

paite: Sul ah a-unaupa akhetul in aman a; apichin in Pathian ah thilhihtheihna anei hi.
english: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he contended with God.

paite: Ahi, angel tung ah thilhihtheihna anei a, avualzouta a; akap a, akiang ah zahngaihna angen hi; Bethel ah amah amu a, huai ah kou ahon houpih hi.
english: Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication to him. He found him at Bethel, and there he spoke with us—

paite: TOUPA mahmah, sepaihte' Pathian, TOUPA theihgigena ahi.
english: even Yahweh, the God of Armies. Yahweh is his name of renown!

paite: Huaiziak in nang na Pathian lam nga in; zahngaihna leh vaihawmna kem in, na Pathian ngak nilouh in.
english: Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.

paite: Amah Kanaan mi ahi, akhut ah khemna buknate a-om; nuaisiah a-utlam ahi.
heading: Thukhenna Omlaite
english: A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.

paite: Ephraim in, "Taktak in ka hong hauta a, hauhsakna ka kimuhkhiakta hi; ka sepgimna tengteng ah thulimlouhna thilhih-khelhna kei ah bangmah amu kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich. I have found myself wealth. In all my wealth they won’t find in me any iniquity that is sin.”

paite: Himahleh Aigupta gam a kipan kei TOUPA na Pathian ka hi; ankuanglui thupi lai nite bang in, puaninte a teng ding in nang ka hon bawl lai ding hi.
english: “But I am Yahweh your God from the land of Egypt. I will yet again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.

paite: Zawlneite kiang ah leng thu ka genta a, mengmuhnate ka tamsakta hi; zawlneite nasepna zang in kibatpihte ka zangta hi.
english: I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.

paite: Gilead thulimlouhna ahi hia? Bangmah lou ahi vek uh; Gilgal ah bawngtalte in akithoih ua; amaitamte uh loukaihna a leivup bang in a-om uh.
english: If Gilead is wicked, surely they are worthless. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls. Indeed, their altars are like heaps in the furrows of the field.

paite: Aram lou a Jakob atailut bang in, Israel in zi loh ding in nna asem, zi loh ding in belamhon aching hi.
english: Jacob fled into the country of Aram. Israel served to get a wife. For a wife he tended flocks and herds.

paite: Aigupta a kipan zawlnei in TOUPA'N Israel apikhia a, zawlnei a hawi in a-om hi.
english: By a prophet Yahweh brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.

paite: Nakpi mahmah in Ephraim in TOUPA ahehsak a; huaiziak in amah tung ah asisan nutsiat in a-om ding, amah gensiatna TOUPA'N akiang lam ah akiksak nawn ding hi.
english: Ephraim has bitterly provoked anger. Therefore his blood will be left on him, and his Lord will repay his contempt.
